name: revolut-gateway-demo
description: Merchant demo comparing Embedded Checkout and Hosted payment page/redirect Checkout integrations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
